# Printable placement cards

*One card per site, to sit beside the tag. Generated by `scripts/build_nfc_tags.py` from the canonical contract — do not hand-edit.*


> **Every destination is reachable without NFC.** Each card carries a QR code and the URL in plain text. NFC is a convenience layer, never the only door: a visitor with an older phone, with NFC switched off, or with no phone at all must still be able to reach the same page.


> **Placement requires the facility manager's permission.** These cards do not grant it and must not be presented as though it has been given.

**What is being considered here**

This site is one of twelve being screened for possible public EV charging. Nothing has been
approved, funded, or scheduled.

**Tap the coin with your phone, or scan the code, or type:**

`https://futurecityfellowship.andyyaro.com/t/FFX004`

*Screening-class planning information. Not an approval, a permit, or a commitment.
Electrical capacity here is an unconfirmed placeholder.*

</td>
